title: A calibration graph
caption: Standards of known concentration are measured and a best-fit line drawn. The unknown's absorbance, 0.300, is read across to the line and down: 5.85 mg dm⁻³. The unknown must lie within the range of the standards.
alt: Absorbance against concentration for six standards from 0 to 10 mg dm⁻³ with a best-fit straight line; dashed lines read an unknown absorbance of 0.300 across to the line and down to about 5.9.
description: Six standards: absorbance rises in proportion to concentration.
Unknown: A = 0.300, so c = 5.85 mg dm⁻³.
